no_fuel_data.title: Log a few fill-ups
no_fuel_data.body: Fill the tank and log it a few times in a row. Once there are two full fills, Axlebook can work out your real economy and spot changes.

economy_down.title: Economy has dropped {{pct}}%
economy_down.body: Your last few fill-ups are well below your usual. Check tire pressure, look for dragging brakes, and think about a dirty air filter or a sensor fault before it gets worse.

economy_up.title: Economy is up {{pct}}%
economy_up.body: Your last few fill-ups beat your usual. Whatever changed (driving, tires, a service) is working.

partial_fills.title: {{pct}}% of recent fills were partial
partial_fills.body: Economy can only be measured between full tanks. Filling up all the way more often gives you more accurate numbers.

missed_fillups.title: {{count}} recent fill-ups were marked missed
missed_fillups.body: A missed fill-up breaks the calculation for that stretch. Logging every fill keeps your average honest.

overdue_affects_economy.title: Overdue: {{title}}
overdue_affects_economy.body: This job is overdue and it can cost you fuel. Getting it done may bring your economy back up.

season_winter_fuel.title: Cold weather costs fuel
season_winter_fuel.body: Expect economy to drop in winter: engines take longer to warm up and winter fuel blends carry less energy. Combine short trips where you can.

season_winter_ev.title: Winter range drops
season_winter_ev.body: Cold batteries hold less and heating draws power. Precondition while plugged in and use seat heaters before cabin heat.

season_storage.title: Getting ready for storage
season_storage.body: Before the off-season: fill the tank and add stabilizer, change the oil, put the battery on a maintainer and cover it somewhere dry.

season_spring.title: Spring wake-up
season_spring.body: Check the tires, battery, brakes and chain or belts, and look for nests or chewed wires before the first ride.

season_sled_storage.title: Storing the sled for summer
season_sled_storage.body: Fog the engine or run stabilized fuel through it, grease the suspension, loosen track tension and store it off the ground on a stand.

season_preseason.title: Pre-season check
season_preseason.body: Before the snow: check the clutches and drive belt, the track and hyfax, the carbides and skis, and that the battery holds a charge.

tire_pressure.title: Check tire pressure monthly
tire_pressure.body: Underinflated tires waste fuel and wear faster. Use the pressure on the door placard or in the manual, checked cold.

smooth_driving.title: Smooth driving saves fuel
smooth_driving.body: Gentle starts, looking ahead and coasting to stops can save more fuel than any additive.

remove_weight.title: Clear out the extra weight
remove_weight.body: Roof racks and boxes and a loaded trunk all cost fuel. Take off what you aren't using.

cruise_control.title: Use cruise control on the highway
cruise_control.body: Holding a steady speed on flat roads uses less fuel than small speed changes. Every 5 mph over 50 costs noticeably more.

moto_chain.title: Keep the chain clean and adjusted
moto_chain.body: A dry or tight chain wastes power and wears the sprockets. Clean, lube and check slack every few hundred miles.

offroad_air_filter.title: Clean the air filter often
offroad_air_filter.body: Dust kills off-road engines. Clean and re-oil a foam filter after dusty rides, not just on schedule.

sled_clutch.title: Keep the clutches clean
sled_clutch.body: Belt dust in the clutches hurts performance and fuel use. Clean them and check belt deflection each season.

sled_track.title: Set track tension right
sled_track.body: Too tight wastes power, too loose risks ratcheting. Check tension and alignment every few rides.

semi_idle.title: Cut idle time
semi_idle.body: Idling burns close to a gallon an hour. An APU, bunk heater or idle shutdown pays for itself quickly.

semi_speed.title: Watch the top speed
semi_speed.body: Above about 60 mph aerodynamic drag climbs fast. A few mph slower can add a few tenths of mpg.

semi_tires_alignment.title: Tires and alignment
semi_tires_alignment.body: Keep every position at the right pressure and check alignment. Low tires and scrubbing axles cost fuel every mile.

semi_aero.title: Close the gaps
semi_aero.body: Side skirts, a tight trailer gap and trailer tails cut drag. Keep fairings adjusted to the trailer you pull.

trailer_tires.title: Trailer tires age out
trailer_tires.body: Check the date codes. Trailer tires often fail from age before tread wear, and underinflated ones overheat.

trailer_bearings.title: Check the wheel bearings
trailer_bearings.body: Feel the hubs after a run: a hot hub means a bearing or brake problem. Repack or check the seals on schedule.

ev_precondition.title: Precondition while plugged in
ev_precondition.body: Heating or cooling the cabin and battery from the wall instead of the battery adds range, especially in winter.

ev_battery_care.title: Easy on the battery
ev_battery_care.body: For daily driving, charging to around 80% and avoiding sitting at 0% or 100% keeps the battery healthy longer.

assistant.title: Local assistant (Ollama)
assistant.intro: It runs on this server through Ollama. Whatever it fills in is a suggestion: nothing is saved until you check the form and press Save.

assistant.reviewHint: Here's what the assistant read. Check every field, fix anything it got wrong, then save.
